evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated strong performance on knowledge-intensive and reasoning-based vision-language benchmark datasets, but still struggle to solve the visual questions that people can solve easily.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: The best pass@3 score is 65.6% across eight evaluated MLLMs.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: HumanSightBench contains 2,876 visual questions with short answers across 7 top-level perceptual categories and 21 subcategories.
